tests.description: Check that the html element has a valid lang attribute defining the default human language
Check that the page has a non-empty title element
Check that meaningful images have non-empty, descriptive text alternatives (not filenames)
Check that images with role=presentation/none do not have conflicting non-empty text alternative attributes
Check color contrast ratios meet WCAG minimums: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text (>=18pt or >=14pt bold)
Check that form controls have accessible names via label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title
Check that links have non-empty accessible names from text content, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title
Check that data tables have th elements or ARIA columnheader/rowheader roles for header association
Check that auto-playing audio elements have a controls attribute or mechanism to stop playback
Composite test: passes only when all non-interference sub-tests pass (21.D-AudioControl, etc.)
